title: Value type incorrectly identified in RegistryPreview

status.label: Likely fix identified
status.detail: Registry Preview classifies a quoted string beginning with hex: as REG_BINARY, although quotes mark it as a string value.

next_action.label: Review the registry value-type parsing proposal.

judgment.rationale: The parser loses a syntactic distinction before its type decision: quoted string data and unquoted hex data can share the same prefix after quote removal. Make the type decision on the raw .reg value or retain a quoted-string flag.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current parser ordering directly explains the reported type confusion, and the distinction can be preserved without changing valid unquoted binary syntax.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve quoted-string syntax during Registry Preview type detection
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The parser removes quotes before checking for the hex: binary prefix, so a quoted string value can be misclassified as binary.
plan: Keep the raw value or record whether it was quoted before normalization.
Classify quoted values as strings and apply hex: binary parsing only to unquoted registry syntax.
Add regression cases for a quoted "hex:ff" string and an unquoted hex:ff binary value.
verification: Import or preview a .reg file containing a quoted hex:-prefixed string and verify it remains a string.
Verify unquoted hex: binary data continues to be parsed as REG_BINARY.

confidence.rationale: The existing normalization-before-classification order directly matches the reported input shape; both sides of the syntax distinction can be tested.
